climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A wine area in Niederösterreich (Lower Austria), Austria, whose wine is made from Grüner Veltliner and Riesling only. Grüner Veltliner covers 55 percent of its vineyards and Riesling 10, with Zweigelt also planted.
